description: Mid-mountain Visual Crossing forecast points for 40 North American resorts already in data/resorts.json. Elevations were read from the cited pages on 2026-11-28. Coordinates are OpenStreetMap lift vertices. US elevations are USGS EPQS; Whistler Blackcomb and Lake Louise use open-meteo because EPQS does not cover Canada. The migration writes only forecastPoint and does not change Latitude or Longitude.

skipped.reason: The Wikipedia ski-area infobox lists the base as 2,610 ft at Summit East and the summit as 5,420 ft at Alpental. Those are different mountains. The seed coordinate is at Snoqualmie Pass, and no published base and summit pair for that base area was found. Combining the two mountains would invent a vertical, so the resort is omitted.
